title: fix(plugin-detail): a related tab's 「+ 添加」 picker keeps to the parent's own records and names them by their name field (#36707)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8TsQcYbERTSLy2YcnwnC3Mn)_

Fixes #36707

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在商机的「合同」页签点「添加」，选择框只列出这个商机所属客户自己的、尚未关联商机的合同，不再混进别的客户的合同；第一列显示合同编号（列名「合同编号」），不再是一列空白的英文「NAME」。
- 属于记录详情页重做专题，补的是上一张修合同页签「添加」时顺路发现的问题：一键就能把别的客户的合同挂到这个商机上。
- 出错的话只是某些页签的「添加」选择框里少列或多列了几条候选、或改成直接新建，不改任何已有数据，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The related tab's 「+ 添加」 (objectstack#35601) derives its picker from the relationship when the page authors no `add` (`derivedAddOf`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`). For a child linked by a plain `lookup`, the picker lists the child object's **unlinked** rows and a pick re-parents them. Two defects, both measured on HotCRM (opportunity "Initech Cloud Migration" → 合同 tab):

1. **The relationship lookup's `dependsOn` was ignored.** `crm_contract.crm_opportunity` declares `dependsOn: ['crm_account']`: on a contract's form the opportunity picker lists only opportunities of the contract's account. The derived picker sent only `crm_opportunity is_empty`, so it listed unlinked contracts of every account, and a pick linked another customer's contract to this opportunity.
   Now the lookup arm reverses that scope from the parent record (`parentScopeOf`): a `dependsOn` entry `{ field, param }` (a bare string names both) sends the child's `field` as the parent object's `param` (`LookupField`'s `dependentFilter`), so a child can name this parent only when its `field` equals the parent's `param`. Each entry becomes the rule `field equals PARENT.param`, added beside `is_empty`. The parent record is the record page's `RecordContext` (already read by this component for the parent currency); an expanded reference reads as its id.
   When the scope cannot be resolved, the tab offers **no picker** and 「+ 添加」 takes the existing no-picker path (New with the parent filled): the parent has no value for a `dependsOn` field (no child could name it), the parent record is not in context, or the lookup's `lookupFilters` compare with `{ $record }` (any operator, which this side does not invert). An unscoped lookup (static `lookupFilters` included) keeps today's unlinked-only picker. The `master_detail` catalog arm and an authored `add` are untouched.
2. **The picker's label column was a hard-coded `name`.** With no `add.picker.labelField` (a derived add never has one), `pickerDisplayField` fell back to `name`; a contract's name field is `contract_number`, so the first column was headed 「NAME」 (the dialog's title-cased fallback for a field the schema does not declare) and was empty. The label column is now the picked object's name field, `resolveNameField(pickerSchema)` (ADR-0079: declared `nameField`, else the derived title field), under that field's served label; `name` only until the picker's schema is read. An authored `labelField` still wins. This also names the record in the batch-refusal message, which reads the same field.

Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch. No new export, key or route.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.derivedAddScope-36707.test.tsx`:

- `derivedAddOf`: a `dependsOn` lookup gets `account equals A-1` from the parent, for a string entry and a `{ field, param }` entry; an expanded parent reference reads as its id; no picker when the parent's value is empty or the parent record is absent; no picker when the relationship's `lookupFilters` read `$record`; control: an unscoped lookup with a static `lookupFilters` keeps `[is_empty]` alone, parent read or not;
- rendered opportunity 合同 tab (parent `account: A-1`, a pool with one contract of A-1 and one of A-2): the picker shows only the own contract, every picker read carries `A-1` beside `is_empty`, and the first header is the name field's label 「Contract Number」 with no 「Name」 column; with no parent account, 「+ 添加」 calls New and no picker read is made; with no declared `nameField`, the derived title field leads and no 「Name」 column appears.

`RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524.test.tsx`: its candidate fixture rows (the `task` object, whose derived title field is `subject`) now carry `subject` beside `name`, so the refusal-message tests keep naming the picked row by the field the picker now shows.

Ablation, one leg per behaviour, each with the fix committed (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed and restored with `git diff HEAD` empty):

- `const scope = parentScopeOf(rel, parentRecord)` → `[]`: 7 of 9 new tests fail (every scope test and both rendered scope tests); restored: 9/9.
- `labelField || resolveNameField(pickerSchema) || 'name'` → `labelField || 'name'`: the 2 label-column tests fail (`["Name","Contract Number","Account","Opportunity"]`); restored: 9/9.

## Acceptance notes

- `dependsOn` scopes the picker only (as on the form): the server does not refuse a contract whose opportunity belongs to another account. A save-side rule, if wanted, is a separate card.
- A relationship lookup whose `lookupFilters` read `{ $record }` now offers no picker on its related tab (it used to offer an unscoped one). Inverting those comparisons (eq only, one hop) is possible but is not needed by any measured tab; noted, not done.
- A static `lookupFilters` on the relationship (which parents a child may name, e.g. only open opportunities) is not checked against the parent here; read from code, not reproduced.
- The empty 「NAME」 column was not contract-specific: it appeared on every picker whose `add` names no `labelField` and whose object's name field is not literally `name`; all of them now lead with the object's name field.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, `parentScopeOf` and the lookup arm of `derivedAddOf` (riskiest hunk: an unresolved scope returns no picker, which changes 「+ 添加」 to New on those tabs).
2. `pickerDisplayField` (one line) and the `derivedAdd` memo, which now depends on the parent record.

Browser, HotCRM `origin/main` (`e2ee348`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) behind this branch's Console (Vite, `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`), zh-CN, at `d7bceceb`:

- Opportunity "Initech Cloud Migration" (account Initech Solutions) → 合同 tab → 「+ 添加」: the dialog lists one row, CTR-0003 / Initech Solutions; CTR-0004 (Stark Medical, also unlinked) is not offered. Headers `["合同编号","所属客户","状态","开始日期"]`.
- The picker's request: `GET /api/v1/data/crm_contract?populate=crm_account&top=10&skip=0&filter=[["crm_opportunity","is_empty"],["crm_account","equals","SlX6mEUIGqvFAEbb"]]` (the opportunity's own account id).
- Before (`origin/main`, the card's repro): the same click listed CTR-0004 beside CTR-0003 under an empty 「NAME」 column, with only the `is_empty` rule.

Screenshots are attached in the project thread (GitHub's image store takes browser uploads only): the opportunity's 合同 tab; the 「添加」 dialog with only the account's own contract.

Two-minute check: on a HotCRM opportunity, open the 合同 tab and click 「+ 添加」: only that account's unlinked contracts appear, led by 合同编号.
